sectors.ai: Buy the US tech complex into strength; the AI compute cycle is reaccelerating with PLTR, ZBRA, ARM, and MRVL confirming broad-based demand beyond pure megacaps. For Indonesia, the signal is indirect but positive: export-linked commodity tech and data-center buildout names should outperform local IT services. Rotate any underweight into US-listed semis and software via cross-listed access; avoid chasing Indonesian tech laggards until local earnings confirm.

Post-election policy stability and government food-security programs create a supportive regulatory backdrop for staple producers, reducing input-cost volatility and enabling margin recovery.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names on momentum, but rotate out of crowded large caps; ENZO, PADA, and MBTO show volume-backed breakouts with 20-40% upside if IDX liquidity holds. Favor exporters (ESTI, MERI) on rupiah tailwinds and domestic staples with pricing power. Trim AGAR/UDNG into strength; set trailing stops at 10% to lock gains.
